owner_note: Find reusable utilities from supplied source. Give concrete dependencies, integration steps and limits. Do not claim tests passed, infer abandonment or recommend files whose contents were not supplied.
summary_json: {"overview":"Deadbolt is a local execution gate for software agents that checks leases, tool policy, spend caps and operator revocation before each tool call, recording structured evidence in SQLite and JSONL. Call admit(agent_id, tool, dest) immediately before each side effect and execute only when the result decision equals allow. The sidecar server side is not in the supplied source; its endpoints are inferred from the client paths.","limitations":["Only examples/deadbolt_client.py content was supplied; src/serve.rs is listed in the tree but its contents were not shown.","Fail-closed behaviour is implemented by _down, which returns deny or store_unavailable for any exception.","Tokens are read from the DEADBOLT_TOKEN environment variable; the sample does not show secure storage of tokens.","Windows default endpoint is hard-coded to 127.0.0.1:9782."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"Node sidecar client","path":"examples/deadbolt_client.js","description":"Dependency-free Node.js client for the Deadbolt HTTP sidecar supporting Unix socket and loopback TCP, exporting ensure, admit, registerChild, status, policy and spend, with deny-by-default error handling.","category":"API & networking","dependencies":["Node.js core modules (http, net, os, path)"],"related_paths":["src/serve.rs","examples/deadbolt_client.py"],"test_paths":["tests/client_contract.py"],"integration_notes":"Require the module from a Node project with DEADBOLT_SOCK and DEADBOLT_TOKEN set. Gate execution on the resolved value of admit and proceed only when decision is allow. Any non-2xx response, empty body or parse failure is converted to a deny-like object.","limitations":["Only the client file was supplied; server-side behaviour in src/serve.rs was not shown.","The module rejects https:// and non-loopback TCP hosts by throwing, which is caught and converted to a down result.","Socket timeouts are fixed at 5000 ms in the sample."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"Witness-format evidence sink","path":"src/witness.rs","description":"Second EvidenceSink implementation that writes records to a SQLite table with WAL mode and a busy-retry loop, plus a sibling JSONL file, refusing generated-class records and requiring premises for inferred records.","category":"Storage","dependencies":["rusqlite (bundled SQLite)","serde_json","tempfile (tests)"],"related_paths":["src/lib.rs"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"Implement or reuse the EvidenceSink trait and EvidenceRecord, SinkError and EpistemicClass types from src/lib.rs, which were not supplied in full. name: witness
description: A public, queryable memory for reality—preserving observations, exposing inferences, and keeping generated language from masquerading as evidence.
owner_note: Find reusable utilities from supplied source. Give concrete dependencies, integration steps and limits. Do not claim tests passed, infer abandonment or recommend files whose contents were not supplied.
summary_json: {"overview":"Witness is a prototype Rust system that stores observations, inferences and generated records as a SQLite provenance graph, with SHA-256 content identifiers and optional Ed25519 signatures. It also includes Python scripts that preserve and verify a bounded USGS river-gauge response bundle.","languages":["Rust","Python","SQL","Shell"],"frameworks":["sqlx","axum","async-graphql","clap","tokio","ed25519-dalek","serde"],"reusable_pieces":[{"name":"CID and Ed25519 sign/verify helpers","path":"core/src/signing.rs","description":"Provides SigningKeypair generation and hex I/O, sign_node and verify_node over a canonicalized node excluding the signature field, plus compute_cid and verify_cid over serde JSON bytes. Includes unit tests for an unchanged node and a tampered payload.","category":"Authentication","dependencies":["ed25519-dalek 2.x","sha2 0.10","hex 0.4","rand 0.8","serde","serde_json","chrono","uuid"],"related_paths":["core/src/types.rs","core/src/lib.rs"],"test_paths":["core/src/signing.rs"],"integration_notes":"Copy the signing module together with the ProvenanceNode, Author, Signature, CID and EpistemicType definitions from core/src/types.rs, or adapt the CanonicalNode struct to your own node type. Export or re-create the Result alias and WitnessError variants used for Crypto and Serialization errors. The canonical form is serde_json output of a private struct, so the field order and serialization must be kept identical on signing and verifying sides.","limitations":["Canonicalization relies on serde_json serialization of struct fields and serde_json::Value payloads, not a formal canonical JSON standard; byte stability across serde_json versions is not established by the sample.","Depends on types from core/src/types.rs that were only partially supplied.","The tests shown only cover unchanged and tampered-payload cases; the sample does not show tests for other failure modes.","Signing proves key possession and non-modification only, not source honesty."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"Append-only SQLite node store","path":"core/src/storage.rs","description":"Storage struct that creates the SQLite file if missing, runs sqlx migrations, inserts nodes and parent edges in a transaction, fetches a node by UUID, and builds filtered queries over epistemic type, domain, author, date range and labels.","category":"Storage","dependencies":["sqlx 0.7 with sqlite, chrono, uuid and json features","tokio","chrono","uuid","serde_json"],"related_paths":["core/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql","core/src/types.rs","core/src/lib.rs"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"Reuse the store_node, get_node and query_nodes pattern with the nodes and edges tables from core/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql. Adjust the sqlx::migrate! path to your migrations directory. The dynamic query builder appends placeholders in order, so keep argument binding order aligned with clause order if you extend the filter.","limitations":["Relies on sqlx::migrate! and a ./migrations path relative to the crate; the sample does not show the full file or its error variants.","store_node uses an INSERT without an upsert, so a duplicate id fails at the database layer; the sample shows no separate append-only enforcement beyond that.","Author and label filters use LIKE substring matching, which can match unintended values.","No tests for this file were seen in the sample.","Only a prefix of the primary source file was analyzed. Inspect the complete file before extraction."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"JSONL and CSV batch ingestion service","path":"core/src/ingestion.rs","description":"IngestionService that validates premises, imports JSONL nodes after checking parent existence, CID match and optional signature, and imports CSV rows as observations via a column mapping.","category":"Data processing","dependencies":["tokio (fs and io)","csv 1.3","serde_json","chrono"],"related_paths":["core/src/storage.rs","core/src/signing.rs","core/src/types.rs","ingestion/src/main.rs"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"The JSONL import pattern (read lines with BufReader, skip blank lines, verify CID and signature before storing) can be lifted independently of the rest of the service. Replace the Storage dependency with your own existence check for parent IDs. The CSV path depends on a CsvColumnMapping type and a csv_record_to_measurement helper whose full source was not supplied in the sample.","limitations":["The file is truncated in the sample; CsvColumnMapping, csv_record_to_measurement and the rest of the service are not visible.","The import path depends on Storage and the project's WitnessError type.","No tests for ingestion were seen in the sample.","Only a prefix of the primary source file was analyzed. Inspect the complete file before extraction."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"USGS bundle extraction and verification scripts","path":"reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/verify.py","description":"Python script that checks manifest.json artifact byte sizes and SHA-256 digests, and confirms that an extracted point's timestamp, exact value text and qualifiers occur in the raw response.json. It prints explicit NOT VERIFIED lines for publisher identity and accuracy.","category":"Developer tools","dependencies":["Python 3 standard library (argparse, hashlib, json, pathlib)"],"related_paths":["reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/extract.py","reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/record_fixity_check.py","reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/retrieve.py","reference/usgs-river-gauge/snapshot/manifest.json"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"Run against a bundle directory containing manifest.json and response.json. The script assumes the USGS WaterML 1.1 JSON structure (value.timeSeries[0].values[0].value). For reuse with another source, the path-walking and point-matching logic must be rewritten for that schema while keeping the digest comparison loop.","limitations":["Hard-coded to the USGS WaterML JSON layout and only checks the first time series.","Digest checks cover only artifacts listed in manifest.json; manifest integrity itself is not established.","No tests were seen in the sample."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"Canonical JSON fixity recorder","path":"reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/record_fixity_check.py","description":"Compares each manifest artifact digest with the file on disk, appends a fixity-check event to preservation-events.json, updates the manifest's digest for that events file, and writes canonical JSON using sorted keys and two-space indentation.","category":"Storage","dependencies":["Python 3 standard library (argparse, hashlib, json, datetime, pathlib)"],"related_paths":["reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/verify.py","reference/usgs-river-gauge/tools/retrieve.py","reference/usgs-river-gauge/snapshot/preservation-events.json"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"The canonical_json and digest helpers are small and can be copied into other archival scripts. The script expects a manifest.json with an artifacts map and an events file with an events list. Pass --checked-at for reproducible runs; otherwise the current UTC time is recorded.","limitations":["The canonical form is json.dumps with sort_keys and indent=2, which is local to this tool and not a published standard.","The tool records the outcome but the sample does not show how mismatches are handled beyond raising SystemExit.","No tests were seen in the sample."],"source_sampled":true},{"name":"Append-only provenance schema","path":"core/migrations/001_initial_schema.sql","description":"SQLite schema with a nodes table constrained to observed, inferred and generated types, a narrative_diffs table, and an edges table with a CHECK constraint over six edge types and indexes on common query columns.","category":"Storage","dependencies":["SQLite 3"],"related_paths":["core/src/storage.rs"],"test_paths":[],"integration_notes":"The schema can be applied as a migration in another SQLite-backed project. Keep the CHECK constraint values aligned with the lowercase epistemic type strings written by store_node in core/src/storage.rs.","limitations":["The sample shows only the initial migration; later migrations and the .sqlx query metadata were not supplied.","The narrative_diffs table is defined but no code using it was seen in the sample.","Foreign keys in SQLite require PRAGMA foreign_keys to be enabled per connection; the sample does not show this being set."],"source_sampled":true}]}
